ITEM 1 | Smooth-skinned, oval, tan-to-medium-brown nut pieces with pointed ends, matte surface with slight sheen, dry and firm, not oily or juicy; about 20 whole pieces clustered in a loose heap on the right side of a white square plate, each roughly 2 to 2.5 cm long and 1.2 cm wide, uncooked-looking with no char or glaze | 22

ITEM 2 | Four or five similar brown oval pieces scattered on the left of the cluster, some split in half to show pale cream interior flesh, dry and firm, each about 1.5 to 2 cm long, sitting directly on the white plate | 5
